title: regelia coriacea
intro: Regelia coriacea, commonly known as the "feather flower" or "native bush-pea", is a flowering plant native to eastern Australia. It has been traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including fever, colds, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Regelia coriacea include alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds and health benefits.
